solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Apple, perhaps, is in favour of offer to study profits

parts.note: to be for something is to favour it
a bid is an offer at auction
a den is a private room for study
fruits are the rewards or profits of labour

explanation.surface: A dealer offers to examine fruit-sale profits, Apple included, in a business-page aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Apple, perhaps' points at the computer company, but the apple meant is the one Eve ate in Eden.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the fruit of the tree of knowledge, traditionally pictured as an apple, is the one Adam and Eve were forbidden to eat.

clue.text: They eat anything at movies, when cooked with last three bits of popcorn

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are worked over and rearranged
the closing three letters of the word popcorn are taken

explanation.surface: Cinema-goers will eat anything when the popcorn is freshly made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last three bits of' takes ORN from popcorn; 'cooked' shuffles MOVIES with ORN.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals with an unrestricted diet of plant and animal food are said to eat anything.

clue.text: Sailor's prize switched compass headings

indicators.note: the compass points north and south in the word are made to trade places

parts.note: a bonus is an extra prize or reward

explanation.surface: A sailor wins a prize for swapping round the ship's compass directions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'switched compass headings' swaps the N and S in BONUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A boatswain, short form used here, is a ship's officer in charge of rigging and deck crew.

clue.text: Dropped diamonds before key broke off

parts.note: D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds
Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard
to break off something is to end it

explanation.surface: A jeweller's diamonds fell before a key snapped off the lock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key' suggests a musical key (a single letter A to G); here it is the keyboard's Esc.
explanation.definitionFit: To have descended is to have gone down, a synonym of dropped.

clue.text: Managing to be master of the internet?

parts.note: the prefix e- marks things of the internet, as in e-mail
a king is a master or ruler

explanation.surface: Asks whether getting by online makes you lord of the web.
explanation.walkthrough: One eking out a living is just managing.
explanation.definitionFit: To eke out is to scrape by or make do, so this participle means just about coping or getting by.

clue.text: Angling to keep in type of school

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it inside, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: angling is fishing with rod and line

explanation.surface: Fishing kept in mind as a sort of school, as a shoal of fish is a school.
explanation.definitionFit: A finishing school is a kind of private school teaching young women social graces.

clue.text: It produces milk shake with top skimmed off

indicators.note: the opening letters of the word are removed, as cream is skimmed from milk

parts.note: to shudder is to shake

explanation.surface: A milkshake made with skimmed milk, its top creamed off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with top skimmed off' removes SH from SHUDDER.
explanation.definitionFit: The mammary gland of a cow or goat, from which milk is drawn.

clue.text: Stock production from clay pit

indicators.note: the letters are produced, reworked into something new

explanation.surface: Ordinary stock goods turned out from a clay pit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stock' looks like a noun (goods or soup); here it is the adjective meaning standard.
explanation.definitionFit: A stock response is a standard, usual one, the same sense as representative or usual.

clue.text: Burns brains

definitions.meaning: to sting with a sharp pain, as a burn does

explanation.surface: Robert Burns the poet credited with brains.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both stings painfully and, informally, sharp intelligence.

clue.text: In dividing, opposite of addition sign

indicators.note: dividing means splitting the other piece in two by sitting in its middle
the opposite of a word is taken here as that word read backwards

parts.note: a sum is an addition of numbers

explanation.surface: A schoolroom arithmetic note about the symbols used for dividing and adding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opposite of' means read backwards, and 'dividing' means sitting in the middle. The arithmetic words all pretend to be the definition, but only 'sign' is.
explanation.definitionFit: The subtraction symbol is one of the signs of arithmetic, the short dash used for taking away.

clue.text: Diet hummus might be fun, if it's not too cold

definitions.meaning: a low-fat chickpea spread, a slimline dip

definitions.text: might be fun, if it's not too cold
definitions.meaning: a naked swim, enjoyable only in warm water

explanation.surface: A dieter's verdict on low-fat hummus, which is fine as long as it is not served chilled.
explanation.definitionFit: Skinny means low-fat and a dip is a dip like hummus; the phrase also means bathing naked.

clue.text: Under no circumstances say each word back in retaliation

indicators.note: each tells us the first word is also turned around on its own

parts.note: never means under no circumstances

indicators.note: word back says the short word for for example is read in reverse

parts.note: e.g. means for example, as say does

explanation.surface: Someone vows never to say a word in retaliation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'each word back' turns NEVER and EG separately, giving REVEN and GE.
explanation.definitionFit: Retaliation is paying back an injury in kind, which is what vengeance is.

clue.text: Flatulence sounds like quirk of the stomach

parts.note: flatulence is wind, gas in the gut

indicators.note: spoken aloud, the word for a quirk gives these letters

parts.note: a trick is a quirk or habit

explanation.surface: Wind noises as a curious feature of the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means relating to the stomach, as in gastric juices.

clue.text: Split without a trace

indicators.note: without means the following letter is left out

parts.note: a bill that is split is shared

explanation.surface: Someone disappears, leaving no trace behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Split' looks like the definition, but it gives SHARED, and 'without' drops the A from it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny scrap or fragment, as in not a scrap of evidence, is a trace.

clue.text: Perhaps sloth yields and topples over

indicators.note: toppling suggests the letters falling and landing in a new order

explanation.surface: A slow animal surrenders and keels over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sloth' looks like the animal; here it is sloth the sin of laziness.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloth is one of the seven cardinal vices of Christian teaching, alongside pride and envy.

clue.text: Release princess's letter

parts.note: Di was the familiar name of Diana, Princess of Wales; with the possessive it gives DIS
a missal, the Mass book, is taken by the setter as a piece of correspondence, its sound close to missive

explanation.surface: A princess's letter announces someone's release.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter treats missal as a letter; the blog accepted it, though a missal is strictly the book of the Mass.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacking an employee or freeing someone from duty is letting them go, a release.

clue.text: Struggled to get away, then ran

parts.note: scram is an order to get away quickly
dye or colour that ran has bled

explanation.surface: Someone fought to escape, then took off at a run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ran' suggests running away; here it is colour bleeding in the wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To scramble is to struggle or clamber hurriedly, as in scrambling for a place.

clue.text: Hint of lilac in street composition

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A faint suggestion of lilac scent in a street's mix of smells.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny trace or spark of something, as in not a trace of evidence.

clue.text: Spectator sees long innings encapsulated by two runs, one scored off the bat

indicators.note: to be encapsulated is to be enclosed by the surrounding pieces

parts.note: a bye is a run scored without the batter hitting the ball
a stand is a long partnership at the crease in cricket
R is the cricket abbreviation for a run, here one hit off the bat

explanation.surface: A cricket scene: a watcher sees a long partnership with two runs added.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a bye is a run taken when the ball passes the bat untouched, so of the two runs only the other was hit; 'encapsulated by' puts the stand between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A bystander is an onlooker present at an event without taking part.

clue.text: Where to get on board and kiss captain

parts.note: buss is an old word for a kiss
the top is the leader or head, as a captain is

explanation.surface: A sailor boarding ship gives the captain a kiss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' suggests a ship; here it means boarding a bus.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadside stop is where passengers board a public road vehicle.

clue.text: Skim opening of literary collection by French writer

indicators.note: the letter is gathered into the writer's name

parts.note: André Gide was a French novelist and Nobel laureate

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: Leafing through the first pages of a French author's collected works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening of' takes L from literary; 'collection by' puts it inside GIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: To skim a surface is to pass lightly and smoothly over it, as one slides.

clue.text: Oriental monster beheaded going out

parts.note: E stands for east, the Orient

indicators.note: the first letter is cut off

parts.note: an ogress is a female monster

explanation.surface: An Eastern she-monster loses her head on the way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beheaded' removes the O from OGRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Egress is the act of exiting, a formal noun for leaving a place.

clue.text: Subtract 500 from irrational number and add remainder

indicators.note: subtract tells us to take the numeral away from the number

parts.note: a surd is an irrational root, like the square root of two
D is the Roman numeral for 500
plus means add

explanation.surface: An arithmetic instruction: take 500 from a number, then add on what is left over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Subtract ... from' removes D from SURD; 'remainder' looks like part of the sum but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A surplus is an excess left over, what remains after needs are met.

clue.text: Be moved by what you do in Take Two?

definitions.text: what you do in Take Two?
definitions.meaning: a second take on a film set means performing the scene again

explanation.surface: A film actor is moved by having to do a second take.
explanation.definitionFit: To respond to a stimulus is the plain sense; read as re-act it means perform again.

clue.text: Small reservoir capsized boat

indicators.note: in a down clue capsized turns the word upside down, reading it upwards

parts.note: a pool is a store of water, a reservoir

explanation.surface: A small boat overturned on a reservoir.
explanation.definitionFit: A single-masted sailing vessel, one kind of boat.

clue.text: Male crustacean missing head and hood

indicators.note: a head is the top of something, and here the word loses its first letter as the creature loses its head

parts.note: a lobster is a large crustacean

explanation.surface: A male lobster has lost its head and its hood-like shell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hood' looks like a garment; it is slang for a gangster (from hoodlum).
explanation.definitionFit: Hood is American slang for a hoodlum, a gang member or criminal.

clue.text: Black paints cause plague

definitions.note: a singular noun for a plural answer: the boils were one of the plagues of Egypt

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
oils are oil paints

explanation.surface: Dark paintings that bring on a plague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plague' looks like a verb; it is one of the ten biblical plagues of Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: In Exodus, festering sores on people and beasts were the sixth of the Egyptian afflictions.

clue.text: To get mushroom risotto (not Irish), load is blended

indicators.note: blended ingredients are mixed together in a new order
not tells us to remove the letters from the dish's name

parts.note: RI stands for the Republic of Ireland, so for Irish

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: for mushroom risotto, leave out the Irish touch and blend in the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' drops RI (Republic of Ireland) from risotto, leaving SOTTO; 'is blended' shuffles it with LOAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A toadstool is an umbrella-shaped fungus, commonly a poisonous kind of mushroom.

clue.text: Reportedly, they get 29 loafs

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said aloud

parts.note: objects of worship are placed on plinths and revered

explanation.surface: Reports say lazy people get worshipped.
explanation.walkthrough: 29 across means worship, so 'they get 29' are idols.
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf is to laze about doing nothing, the same as lounging lazily.

clue.text: Worship pope and salute the leader in revolution

indicators.note: in revolution means the letters are turned over into a new order
the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Revolutionaries worship the pope and salute their leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' takes T from 'the'; 'in revolution' shuffles POPE, AND, SALUTE and T.
explanation.definitionFit: To idolise someone is to treat them as exalted, to revere them extravagantly.
